scope: Real production terminal page/xterm/CSS in Chromium with test-only Firefox service adapter; real native PTY helper and isolated tmux. NOT installed Zen/native menu proof.

checks.name: Real helper and tmux start the rendered production terminal page
Rapid repeated keyboard letters are delivered exactly once
Unicode keyboard insertion and terminal paste preserve exact text
Actual stty follows visible terminal resizing
Large output stays bounded and the last rendered line is present
Scrollback search is literal, keyboard-accessible and never executes query text
Reload reconnects to the same shell and does not repeat startup
Saved starting folder is literal; edits apply only to new jobs
Disconnect offers reconnect without deleting the saved shell
Missing helper shows a recoverable error and preserves saved work
Copied profile uses its own tmux shell even with the same saved session id
Lost session requires explicit Start again and reload never repeats startup
Without tmux, live resizing and real scrollback remain usable and bounded
